task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .

stepresult.p: A box opens in the middle of the window. It starts with the words and asks how to save your tree.

step.cmd: Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves everything in one file, with its pictures. Choose this one.
saves your tree as a family tree file, without pictures. Use it only for a program that cannot read GEDZIP. A second box asks . Choose GEDCOM 7 unless that program is old.

step.cmd: In the window that opens, choose a folder, such as Documents, then choose .

stepresult.p: A line at the foot of the window names the copy and its folder.

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new one after you add a lot. Keep one off your Mac too.
result.note: If you opened a file from another program, keeps its own copy. The file you chose does not change.
